title: Pocket Enablement Guides and Demo Sprint for runtime-1.19 Release
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: equip Sales and Customer Success with ultra-compact, role-specific enablement artifacts and a focused demo sprint so reps can quickly show runtime-1.19 improvements (batching latency reductions, KV cache prefetch, and model fallback routes). Deliverables: 1) Pocket Guides: three one-page PDFs (Sales quick bullets, CS troubleshooting flows, Partner/SE technical talking points). 2) Demo Sprint materials: 6 scripted demo scenarios with expected prompts, environment setup notes (hosted vs dedicated), and fallback testing checklist. 3) TL;DR release notes summary tailored for customer-facing teams (2/3 slide summary + 3 minute spokesperson script). 4) FAQ distilled from engineering release notes and SRE runbook. Acceptance criteria: artifacts reviewed and signed off by ENG + DES + CS lead; live demo recorded and accessible in Drive; at least 2 Sales reps validated the talk track in roleplay session. Success metric: >=90% of trained reps rate materials as "ready to pitch" in post-training survey.
